time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0
description: Overhead (top-down) view of one swimmer doing front crawl (freestyle) in a pool lane between two lane ropes; swimmer moves toward the TOP of the image (-y). Static camera.

camera.motion: static (background shift < 1 px/frame; lane-rope float pattern drifts ~7 px over the whole clip, consistent with ropes bobbing, not a pan)
camera.view: near-vertical top-down; swimmer, ropes and pool floor marks approximately in one plane -> one px scale is reasonable
camera.per_frame_bg_shift: see scene/bgshift_raw.json (phase correlation per strip: (dx,dy,response)); |dx|,|dy| < 1 px in rope strips for all frames
camera.duplicate_note: these frames are pixel copies of the previous frame (frame-rate conversion); the object shows 0 displacement on them and ~21 px on the neighbours. Per-frame diffs at these frames are artefacts.

swimmer.distinguish: only person in the video; black swim trunks, black/white swim cap; centre lane
swimmer.motion: swims toward image top (-y), nearly straight (x stays 940-1040)

reference_points.cx,cy: visible-mask centroid (includes arms; shifts with arm stroke)
reference_points.hip_x,hip_y: centroid of black trunks = pelvis proxy

lane_rope_left.float_pattern: groups of red, blue, white floats; red groups repeat every ~202 px (each red group ~58 px long, single float ~20-30 px)

lane.width_between_rope_centres_px: ~1364 at y=1920 frame 0 (1350-1400 depending on y/frame; ropes bow slightly)

pool_floor_marks.distinguish: faint dark rectangular markings on the pool floor in neighbouring lanes, x ~0-200 and ~1850-2100, y ~900-1900 (frame 0); also a faint dark lane line under the swimmer ~x 950-1100
pool_floor_marks.note: low contrast, distorted by water surface

events.event: swimmer already moving at frame 0, still moving at frame 71 (no start/stop)
right arm (image right) recovery, widest sideways sweep
right arm extended forward ahead of head (entry/glide)
left arm (image left) recovery, widest sweep (bbox width 504 px)
right arm recovery, widest sweep (bbox width 504 px)
left arm extended forward at start

stroke_cycle: right-arm recovery peaks at frames ~10 and ~66 -> one full stroke cycle ~56 frames (~3.0 s); arm recoveries alternate every ~28 frames
